scope: 26 unseen pending research candidates across six newly populated research topics. No catalog promotion or new published catalog categories.

method.codex_lead_review: Rechecked live metadata and README evidence for every selected record, checked all 3,203 baseline IDs plus cross-agent duplicates, narrowed unsupported summaries, preserved license ambiguities, and reconciled discovery sources with observed search IDs.
method.observation_semantics: Counts are returned rows in bounded pages, including repeated IDs across queries; not unique candidates or total GitHub result counts.
